local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: Total is the Class of 2028 figure (Personal Finance and Environmental Science added, p.2): English 4, Social Sciences 3.5, Mathematics 3.5, Science 3.5, Health/PE 2, Creative Arts 1, Foreign Language 1, Electives 5. The Class of 2027 table (p.2) totals 22.5 credits. Credits are treated as standard credits because the catalog uses the same credit unit in its requirement table; no per-course conversion is stated, so this is recorded as stated.

notes: Current catalog is 2025-26; the file is named catalog_2025-26.pdf and the 2026-27 catalog was not in the input. Graduation rests on 92 enduring graduation proficiencies plus credit totals (p.2). Science requires proficiency in the seven enduring standards across at least three science content areas, with Environmental Science required from the Class of 2028 (p.8). Requirements for the Class of 2027 and 2028 differ: the Class of 2027 table lists 22.5 credits and the Class of 2028 table 23.5 credits (the Class of 2027 table heading reads 'addition of 5 elective credits', which is unclear). Students must have a Personal Learning Plan (p.3). Schedule type, courses per term and credit per course are not stated in the catalog text. The Dartmouth program runs on a trimester basis (p.4), but that is Dartmouth's calendar, not the school's. The school sends students to two technical centers (River Valley and Stafford) (p.4). Transferable Skills proficiencies are gathered through Community Based Learning (p.4), but the catalog does not state them as a graduation requirement.
